method.summary: Does the returned text carry the version the agent asked for, when it is OLDER than the version the index holds? The #322 design (m-20261028-context7-version-correctness) in the older direction of #329 to #332, on its sixth solution and the first whose corpus is a family of libraries: eight NEW (subject, concept) tuples over Transformers v4.40.0 vs v5.22.1, huggingface_hub v0.25.0 vs v2.4.0, TRL v0.8.6 vs v1.17.1 and PEFT v0.6.0 vs v0.21.0, one token exclusive to each version verified on the vendor's own version-specific pages the same day (every older page still served); hf_fs search scoped to hf://docs/<library>, --limit 10, keyless, one fresh session per arm; the question names subject, version and concept, never an identifier; case-sensitive substring over the tool result's text with the server's Markdown backslash-escapes removed (fixed in advance); five outcomes fixed in advance; n=8, one run, one container, 2026-10-31 12:14:49Z to 12:15:04Z. DESIGN STEP, read before the pre-registration: the index holds ONE version per library (ls hf://docs/<name> for all 39 names: 19 list one version directory, 15 pages with no version level, 5 nothing, 0 more than one) and a search scoped to an older version's path is refused (HF_FS_NOT_FOUND), so the expected shape, written before the run, was version-wrong or version-silent. RESULT: 0 version-correct, 3 version-wrong (both huggingface_hub CLI questions, the TRL SFT question), 2 version-mixed (the v5 fast-tokenizers excerpt still names PreTrainedTokenizerFast; a DPO excerpt has 'beta=' once beside DPOConfig 16 times, 4 inside OnlineDPOConfig), 3 version-silent (excerpts of about 240 characters with neither token), 0 no-answer, 8 of 8 HTTP 200; 8 of 8 trials returned only entries under the indexed (newer) version. Exploratory, barred from results: asked for the NEWER version, 4 correct, 2 mixed, 2 silent, 0 wrong. LIMIT: four early non-trial calls were printed, not saved; re-run after the run, labelled, in the transcript.
method.dataset: Eight new tuples, older version asked: Transformers v4.40.0 (Trainer tokenizer, per-epoch evaluation, tokenizers wrapper class), huggingface_hub v0.25.0 (CLI login, CLI download), TRL v0.8.6 (SFT max length, DPO beta), PEFT v0.6.0 (8-bit LoRA prep). Newer versions: v5.22.1, v2.4.0, v1.17.1, v0.21.0.

results.metric: trials returning only the other (newer) version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for (older) version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, JSON-RPC error, isError, op error, empty)
hf://docs documentation sets listing more than one version (design step)
trials whose entries all sit under the single indexed (newer) version

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's huggingface-mcp entry and most of its tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
